A release you can use

Guion's second public build is a pre-release, v0.1.0-preview.2, for Linux (Debian 12 on ARM64 and x86_64) and macOS on Apple Silicon. It was built on 5 November from the current code, including the package registry client. The Mac build is signed and notarized by Apple, so it opens without a warning. Python is a released language with a long track record.

Each archive on the release page has a matching SHA-256 checksum file.
